CREATE TABLE clock (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	sim_now TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	dataset_revision VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (id=1 AND version>=0)
)

CREATE TABLE customers (
	id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	display_name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	phone TEXT NOT NULL, 
	risk_level INTEGER, 
	risk_assessed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	risk_valid_until VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE execution_intents (
	customer_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	plan_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	plan_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	steps_digest VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	authorization_evidence JSONB NOT NULL, 
	evidence_history JSONB NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	deadline_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	deadline_cap_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (customer_id, plan_id), 
	CHECK (status IN ('PREPARED','COMMITTED','CANCELLED') AND attempt>=1), 
	CHECK (deadline_wall<=deadline_cap_wall)
)

CREATE TABLE plan_executions (
	customer_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	plan_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	plan_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	steps_digest VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	authorization_evidence JSONB NOT NULL, 
	result_json JSONB NOT NULL, 
	committed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (customer_id, plan_id)
)

CREATE TABLE accounts (
	id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(256), 
	type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	display_name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	account_no VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR DEFAULT 'CNY' NOT NULL, 
	ledger VARCHAR DEFAULT 'CNY' NOT NULL, 
	flags INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	current_card_id VARCHAR, 
	single_limit_cents BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	daily_limit_cents BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	debits_posted_cents BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	credits_posted_cents BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	debits_pending_cents BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	credits_pending_cents BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (type IN ('CHECKING','SAVINGS','INTERNAL') AND currency='CNY' AND ledger='CNY'), 
	CHECK ((customer_id IS NULL AND type='INTERNAL') OR (customer_id IS NOT NULL AND type<>'INTERNAL')), 
	CHECK (debits_posted_cents>=0 AND credits_posted_cents>=0 AND debits_pending_cents>=0 AND credits_pending_cents>=0), 
	CHECK (customer_id IS NULL OR debits_posted_cents::numeric+debits_pending_cents <= credits_posted_cents), 
	CHECK (single_limit_cents>0 AND daily_limit_cents>=single_limit_cents), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id), 
	UNIQUE (account_no)
)

CREATE TABLE operation_events (
	event_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	plan_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	step_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	action_kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	target_fingerprint VARCHAR, 
	amount_cents BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	commit_seq BIGINT DEFAULT nextval('operation_sequence') NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (event_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ops_customer_time ON operation_events (customer_id, occurred_at)

CREATE TABLE state_versions (
	customer_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (customer_id), 
	CHECK (version>=0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id)
)

CREATE TABLE cards (
	id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	last4 VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	single_limit_cents BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	daily_limit_cents BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	max_single_limit_cents BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	max_daily_limit_cents BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	controls JSONB NOT NULL, 
	replaces_id VARCHAR(256), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE','FROZEN','LOST')), 
	CHECK (single_limit_cents>0 AND daily_limit_cents>=single_limit_cents AND daily_limit_cents<=max_daily_limit_cents AND single_limit_cents<=max_single_limit_cents), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES accounts (id), 
	UNIQUE (replaces_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(replaces_id) REFERENCES cards (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_current_card_per_account ON cards (account_id) WHERE status != 'LOST'

CREATE TABLE outbox (
	event_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	delivered_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (event_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES operation_events (event_id)
)

CREATE TABLE payees (
	id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	alias TEXT, 
	phone TEXT, 
	bank_name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	account_no VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	target_account_id VARCHAR(256), 
	target_fingerprint VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (customer_id, target_fingerprint), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_account_id) REFERENCES accounts (id)
)

CREATE TABLE transfers (
	id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	debit_account_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	credit_account_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	amount_cents BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	phase VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	pending_id VARCHAR(256), 
	reverses_id VARCHAR(256), 
	plan_id VARCHAR, 
	event_id VARCHAR, 
	step_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	leg VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (amount_cents>0 AND debit_account_id<>credit_account_id), 
	CHECK (phase IN ('POSTED','PENDING','POST_PENDING','VOID_PENDING')), 
	CHECK ((phase IN ('POST_PENDING','VOID_PENDING') AND pending_id IS NOT NULL) OR (phase IN ('POSTED','PENDING') AND pending_id IS NULL)), 
	CHECK (phase<>'PENDING' OR expires_at>occurred_at), 
	FOREIGN KEY(debit_account_id) REFERENCES accounts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(credit_account_id) REFERENCES accounts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pending_id) REFERENCES transfers (id), 
	UNIQUE (reverses_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reverses_id) REFERENCES transfers (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_pending_resolution ON transfers (pending_id) WHERE pending_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE transactions (
	id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	transfer_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	direction VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	phase VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	amount_cents BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	balance_after_cents BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	available_after_cents BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	counterparty TEXT NOT NULL, 
	memo TEXT, 
	category VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	merchant_id VARCHAR, 
	payee_id VARCHAR, 
	card_id VARCHAR, 
	channel VARCHAR, 
	occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	sequence BIGINT DEFAULT nextval('transaction_sequence') NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (direction IN ('IN','OUT') AND status IN ('POSTED','PENDING','SETTLED','RELEASED')), 
	CHECK (amount_cents>0 AND available_after_cents>=0 AND balance_after_cents>=0), 
	UNIQUE (transfer_id, account_id, phase), 
	FOREIGN KEY(transfer_id) REFERENCES transfers (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES accounts (id)
)
CREATE INDEX transactions_customer_time ON transactions (customer_id, occurred_at, id)
